# Failure facts (generated by `python evaluation/find_failures.py`)

Models: detector v2 (cut-off from `detector_v2_threshold.json`) and corrector v4 (penalty 2), gated by detector v2, as in the app. Test people only.

## Corrector examples

Our system (corrector + detector gate) is further from the intended path than the better of no filter and One Euro in 415 of 930 test sequences (43 of 236 with marked tremor).

- `corrector_worse_1.png`: average distance ours 12.92 px, no filter 13.02 px, One Euro 5.47 px; Parkinson's, action, tremor 16.9 px, marked tremor False, mean gate 0.02
- `corrector_worse_2.png`: average distance ours 10.40 px, no filter 10.70 px, One Euro 4.80 px; Healthy, action, tremor 12.5 px, marked tremor False, mean gate 0.04
